description: CALL THIS for what a shop sells, its products, its prices, a gift idea, or browsing or shopping a store served here. Reads that shop's OWN published catalog: title, maker, type, price, stock and one image per product. Businesses served here: Make Collectives (makecollectives, a boutique and gift shop), Kristin Dunn Bookbinding and Design (kdbooks, a bookbinding and book repair studio). Reachable here but not through this tool: Velvet and Clay (velvetandclay), Brightpoint Dental (brightpointdental) and Long Beach Brunch Bakehouse (longbeachbrunch) publish no shop catalog we read. makecollectives is Make Collectives, a boutique at 430 E. 1st St in Long Beach. kdbooks is Kristin Dunn Bookbinding and Design in Long Beach; her work is MADE TO ORDER, so say what `leadTimeNote` says. TWO SHOP PLATFORMS ARE READ HERE, a Shopify store and a WooCommerce shop, same reply shape; ON A WOOCOMMERCE SHOP ONE CART LINK CARRIES EXACTLY ONE ITEM. `query` only removes products. Sixty a page with `pageCount` and `total`: never say sixty is all. Give `cartUrl` and `shopUrl` exactly as returned, never a link of your own. WHERE THIS REPLY DRAWS THE SHOP CARD, THE CARD ITSELF HOLDS A BASKET: the person taps Add to cart there. Say what `buyingNote` says. No payment passes through Sonar Connections.

business.description: Which business, by name or id. Available: Make Collectives (makecollectives), Kristin Dunn Bookbinding and Design (kdbooks). The default (velvetandclay) publishes no shop catalog we read, so NAME THE BUSINESS: an omitted argument is refused. An unclear name is REFUSED with the list, not answered about a different business.

businessId.description: Alias for `business`; ignored when `business` is given.

query.description: Optional words to narrow the catalog; it only removes products.
